claim: Strava entry: the API Policy makes Standard Tier apps "subject to subscription requirements", including "that the developer or specified end users maintain an active Strava subscription".
quote: Standard Tier Applications are subject to subscription requirements as published on the Strava developer site , including a requirement that the developer or specified end users maintain an active Strava subscription.

claim: Strava entry: the getting-started guide calls a subscription "a prerequisite for creating an app".
quote: A Strava subscription is a prerequisite for creating an app.

claim: Strava entry: the API Agreement (2026), effective June 1, 2026.
Strava entry: says access is "currently provided at no charge".
quote: Access to and use of the Strava API Materials and the Strava Platform are currently provided at no charge.

claim: Strava entry: Strava data may be shown only to the athlete it belongs to.
quote: Strava Data provided by a specific Strava user may be displayed or disclosed in your Developer Application only to that user. You may not display or disclose Strava Data related to other users, even if such data is publicly viewable on the Strava Platform.

claim: Strava entry: the API Policy forbids using it in the development, training, evaluation or operation of any AI application.
quote: You may not use the Strava API Materials or Strava Data, directly or indirectly, in connection with the development, training, evaluation, or operation of any AI Application.

claim: WHOOP entry: a developer must have a WHOOP membership to build an app.
quote: You must have a WHOOP membership to develop an app on the Developer Platform. Your WHOOP account is also your WHOOP developer login.

claim: WHOOP entry: users connect with their own WHOOP accounts.
quote: you can use the OAuth standard to request consent from WHOOP members to access data on their behalf.

claim: Garmin entry: the Personal API is available for personal use.
quote: The Garmin Connect Personal API is available for personal use and is the quickest way to gain access to your data for use in personal applications.

claim: Garmin entry: not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.
quote: It is not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.

claim: Garmin entry: individuals create their own API key on Garmin Connect Web.
quote: Go to the Personal API Key page while logged in to your Garmin Connect Web account

claim: Garmin entry: the business program describes Starter Access and Enterprise Access.
quote: Starter Access: Developers can gain immediate access and launch with Garmin, with access to core data and tools.

claim: Garmin entry: the business program describes Starter Access and Enterprise Access.
quote: Enterprise Access: For companies operating at scale, this new model aligns with growth, offering expanded data access, reliability, and enterprise-grade support.

claim: Garmin entry: the earlier FAQ statement that the program was only for business use (Wayback Machine capture of 17 October 2026).
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.
